query:
SELECT MIN(tp.ctime_at + (h.cooldown * INTERVAL '1 second')) AS next_unlock_at
        FROM rb_hint h
        JOIN rb_team_puzzle tp ON tp.puzzle_id = h.puzzle_id AND tp.team_id = $1
        WHERE h.puzzle_id = $2
            AND h.title_hidden
            AND tp.ctime_at + (h.cooldown * INTERVAL '1 second') > NOW();
